part: Part 34: THE SILENT LOSS — The Age of Super-Languages (Paragraph 34)
scene: The four giant languages (English, Mandarin, Spanish, Hindi) expanding across digital screens, eclipsing tiny dialects.
sample_context: The narrator reflects on modern linguistic consolidation without anger, but with deep acknowledgment of the silent loss.

transcript:
[serious] [reflective]
Har language... ek alag tarah se soch banati hai. Jab woh language marti hai... woh soch bhi mar jaati hai. Aur ek aur cheez.
[reflective] [deep]
Teen lakh saal ki human history mein... pehli baar... hum ek aisi position mein hain jahan kuch dominant languages baaki sabko khatam kar rahi hain... English... Mandarin... Spanish... Hindi.
[conversational] [balanced]
Ye galat nahi hai... ye natural evolution hai communication ka.
[somber] [grave]
Lekin ek loss hai. Aur ye loss... silent hai.
